headline: Ather Energy allots 10.81 million shares via QIP
sum: Ather Energy Limited completed allotment of 10,815,307 equity shares pursuant to a Qualified Institutional Placement on 20 July 2026. The allotment follows board and shareholder approval and marks the company's post-IPO capital raise.
detail: The NSE allotment notice dated 21 July 2026 confirms allotment of 10,815,307 securities to qualified institutional buyers under the QIP framework. Ather Energy, which listed in 2024, conducted this QIP to fund growth initiatives in its electric two-wheeler and battery manufacturing business. The specific issue price and total capital raised are not disclosed in the allotment notice itself; those are typically disclosed in concurrent investor updates or regulatory filings.
